# 110. Semis, fisksoppa och den amerikanska optimismen

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-07-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode 110 of EFN's Börssurr, recorded from the French Riviera, celebrates an exceptionally strong first half-year led by semiconductors (SOX +88% in Q2) and broad American optimism, framing 2026 as a bullish 'gas year' where markets shrug off bad news. The hosts discuss a wave of Nordic M&A and property deals (Castellum selling at premium), the renodling (pure-play spin-off) theme across SKF, Munters, Stora Enso and Billerud, and repeatedly return to Investor as the ideal core holding. Overall mood is optimistic but tinged with contrarian skepticism toward consensus buys and stretched valuations.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 INVE-B — Investor | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Up 22% in H1, trades at a justified premium given proven turnaround ability (Electrolux, world-class holdings); hosts endorse as portfolio base.

#### Reasoning

Framed as the ideal low-effort core holding: buy Investor with everything, sleep well, start young. Premium is deemed rational because a 15-year index-beating record and demonstrated capacity to fix problem holdings warrant paying above NAV. Hosts recommend layering other stocks for fun but keeping Investor as the base.

#### Sell Triggers

- if premium expands to unreasonable levels like Latour
- if track record of turning around holdings breaks
- if it enters the most adventurous/speculative ventures like Stegra

> *"Varför ger livet svårt för sig? Köp index för allt du kan... Köp Investor för allt du kan. Så gott om natten."*

---

### 🟢 CAST — Castellum | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Sold Stockholm properties to Alecta at 12% premium to book, proving it can defend its valuations; hosts speak well of the stock.

#### Reasoning

Two property deals in as many weeks, the latest at a 12% premium to book value, validate Castellum's marks and support the thesis that if property firms transact among themselves the sector's discount should close. Seen as best-in-class going 'from klarhet till klarhet' through its restructuring phase, though hosts caution the sector turn is not confirmed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the market concludes inter-company property swaps are circular/self-dealing
- if the sector discount persists despite premium deals
- if the restructuring phase stalls

> *"Nu sålde man Stockholms fastigheter med 12% premium mot bokfört värde... jag tycker att de går från klarhet till klarhet."*

---

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fastest grower of the ventilation cluster; divesting FoodTech to become a pure-play datacenter cooling winner.

#### Reasoning

Munters has grown fastest among ventilation peers over five years and is now interesting as it renodlar — selling the boring FoodTech unit to reposition as a pure datacenter cooling play, riding the AI/datacenter capex wave. Open question is who buys the divested FoodTech assets, and growth has recently softened.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it cannot find a buyer for the FoodTech divestment
- if datacenter cooling demand cools
- if growth continues to decelerate

> *"Munters är intressant nu när man ska sälja fotech och göra... Renodlad datacentervinnare."*

---

### 🟡 AXFO — Axfood | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Defensive grocery, historically expensive vs limited growth, now weaker growth under new CEO with Willys lagging; hosts unsure if mistrust is justified.

#### Reasoning

Axfood is a safe, high-quality defensive but has always been richly valued relative to modest growth, and now faces a growth dip under new CEO Simone Margeirsson with Willys losing ground. Hosts debate whether market mistrust is warranted; in a risk-on rotation investors may abandon boring defensives for semis, capping upside near-term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the growth soft patch deepens
- if Willys keeps losing share
- if the market rotates decisively into cyclicals/semis away from defensives

> *"Lite svagare tillväxt... man kanske vill in i Semis. Man kanske går från Axfood till Silver Semiconductors."*

---

### 🟠 DUST — Dustin | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

A viewer flags a decent report; cited among beaten-down companies that may be turning around.

#### Reasoning

Dustin came in with a 'hygglig' report, mentioned alongside Klarna and Nike as previously-poor names showing signs of turning. Speculative turnaround watch rather than a conviction call; hosts note it only in passing.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the next report disappoints
- if the recovery proves a one-quarter blip

> *"En tittare påbäckade att även Dustin kom in med en hygglig rapport i dagarna apropå dåliga bolag som ska vända."*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Directed emission (~600m) sent shares down 15% then recovered; shorts flag inconsistent SE/EN disclosures and unclear use of proceeds; thin cash.

#### Reasoning

A cash-poor company raised ~600m in a discounted directed emission; US institutions bought, but bears question whether the money funds real expansion or merely operations, and highlight differing Swedish vs English press releases. The 'what am I paying for' skepticism plus reliance on continued capital raises makes it high-risk despite semis euphoria.

#### Sell Triggers

- if disclosures remain inconsistent between languages
- if proceeds go to opex rather than growth capex
- if further dilutive raises are needed

> *"man frågar sig vad pengarna verkligen ska användas till. Det här är ett bolag som inte har så mycket kassa. Vad fan får jag för pengarna?"*

---

### 🟢 MAERSK-B — Maersk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Raised full-year 2026 guidance; described as a winner on the Hormuz crisis.

#### Reasoning

Maersk lifted its full-year 2026 guidance and is framed as a Hormuz-crisis winner. Host caveats that 'everyone is a winner' when oil is low and equities high — low oil feeds disinflation, rate cuts and higher multiples — so the tailwind is partly a broad-market phenomenon rather than company-specific edge.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Hormuz shipping disruption normalizes
- if freight rates fall back
- if oil spikes and the disinflation narrative reverses

> *"Mersk också som höjde sin helåldsbronas faktiskt för 2026. Vinnaren på Hörmutskris."*

---

### 🟡 ELUX-B — Electrolux | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Large, painful rights issue where Investor took long-term ownership responsibility; host says the ownership warrants a premium.

#### Reasoning

Electrolux is cited approvingly for a big, painful new share issue where anchor owner Investor stepped up long-term — evidence of the responsible ownership that justifies Investor's premium. The comment is about ownership quality more than a standalone Electrolux buy thesis, so conviction on the stock itself is modest.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the turnaround following the rights issue fails to materialize
- if Investor reduces its commitment
- if further capital is required

> *"Ja, men Electrolux då kan man väl säga. Intressant med en stor och smärtsam nyemission där man ändå tar ägaransvar och är långsiktig. Jag tycker också att det är värt ett premie."*

---

### 🟡 ABB — ABB | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Has turned around and is 'so hot now' that hosts question whether it is still worth owning at these levels; largest holding in Investor.

#### Reasoning

ABB is cited among successful turnarounds (with Sandvik and Volvo) and is now the biggest position in Investor, but the hosts openly wonder whether it is still worth daring to own given how hot it has become — a valuation-caution hold rather than a fresh buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation runs further ahead of fundamentals
- if the industrial cycle rolls over
- if order growth decelerates

> *"ABB är så hett nu att man undrar om det fortfarande är liksom... är värt att våga äga. Och avgjort störst i Investor."*

---

### 🟠 BILL — Billerud | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Troubled for years, but new chairman Magnus Nicolin (also at Munters) appointed; forest may be the next renodling theme.

#### Reasoning

Billerud has struggled for years, but the appointment of chairman Magnus Nicolin — who also chairs Munters — is read as a possible catalyst, with forest/paper seen as the next pure-play renodling opportunity. Speculative watch tied to management change and the broader 'forest grows even in recession' narrative rather than current earnings.

#### Sell Triggers

- if pulp/paper prices weaken
- if the new chairman fails to drive restructuring
- if a renodling of forest assets does not materialize

> *"nämner han Billerud apropå skogsindustrin som har dragits med problem i åratal. Men Magnus Nicolén har valt sig ordförande."*

---

### 🟡 SKF-B — SKF | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

To be split and turned around, but some factories serve both business areas, making separation harder than expected; hosts prefer to wait.

#### Reasoning

SKF is a turnaround-plus-split case, but the hosts flag that certain plants serve both segments so the demerger is not as clean as hoped, echoing the 'renodling is harder than it looks' theme. They explicitly say they'll wait, making it a hold pending clarity on the separation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the split proves impractical or destroys value
- if the industrial cycle weakens
- if the turnaround stalls

> *"SKF förstås som vi pratade om som ska delas upp och vändas. Vi väntar väl lite där."*
